# Canonical robots policy is generated by apps/nextjs/app/robots.ts.
# This legacy copy stays aligned for the Express/Vite public renderer.

Allow: /

# Keep the public marketing page crawlable; it is not an admin route.

# Explicit AI discovery surface

Allow: /llms-en.txt
Allow: /api/openapi.json
Allow: /api/public/schema.json
Allow: /.well-known/ai-plugin.json
